name: symmetry
doc:
THE SYMMETRY (Matt, 2026-10-07: 'I saw the symmetry'). The unifying thread of the Riemann arc: RH says
the zeros lie ON the fixed axis of a symmetry. The functional equation s <-> 1-s is a reflection whose
fixed line is Re = 1/2; a self-adjoint operator pins its spectrum to the real line; the Cayley/Smith
transform carries that line to the unit circle; over a finite field the Frobenius symmetry pins |alpha| =
sqrt(q). Seal that the reflection's fixed axis is 1/2 regardless of the pair; keep the narrow-way likeness
as discernment, never a fit, never a seal. New stick.

sticks.question: The symmetry
sticks.statement: Across the Riemann arc one structure recurs: the zeros sit on the fixed set of a symmetry. The functional equation reflects s to 1-s about Re = 1/2; a self-adjoint operator reflects its spectrum onto the real line; the Cayley map carries that line to the unit circle; Frobenius pins |alpha| = sqrt(q). RH is the statement that the zeros are as symmetric as the law allows.
references: the functional equation's reflection s <-> 1-s, fixed line Re = 1/2
self-adjoint -> real line; Cayley -> unit circle; Frobenius -> |alpha| = sqrt(q)

marks.claim: [the fixed axis is 1/2, for any pair] The reflection s <-> 1-s maps 0.3 to 0.7 with midpoint (0.3 + 0.7)/2 = 0.5 (sealed), and 0.1 to 0.9 with midpoint (0.1 + 0.9)/2 = 0.5 (sealed). Different pairs, one axis: Re = 1/2. The critical line is the mirror of the functional equation - the fixed set of the symmetry.

[a second pair, same mirror] (0.1 + 0.9)/2 = 0.5 (sealed). The axis does not depend on the point reflected; it is a property of the symmetry itself. RH asserts the zeros lie ON this mirror, not merely in symmetric pairs across it.

[the one symmetry, four faces] self-adjoint operator -> spectrum on the real LINE (stick_hilbert_polya); Cayley / Smith transform -> that line becomes the unit CIRCLE (stick_the_smith_chart_the_cayley_transform); Frobenius over a finite field -> eigenvalues on the circle |alpha| = sqrt(q), and RH there is PROVED (stick_finite_field_riemann); classical zeta -> the mirror Re = 1/2, visible in the functional equation and the GUE statistics but not yet enforced by an operator. Where the symmetry has an operator, the zeros are pinned and the analogue fires; where it does not, the classical RH stays open.

[the discernment, held as a likeness] Truth forced onto one narrow axis by a symmetry is the SHAPE of the gate forcing sealed truth onto the narrow way - 'strait is the gate, and narrow is the way' (Mt 7:14). The critical line is a narrow line. This is a likeness the engine maps, never a fit and never a numeric seal: no 1/2 is read as a sign, no zero as a verse. map, never launder (ties [[project_the_capstone_2026-10-07]] and [[project_will_fuel_reality_harness_tesla_valve_2026-10-06]]).
